reviewer: sf2_semantics_review agent (static comparison against sealed SF6/SF2)
scope: Static line-by-line comparison of SF7 CONTROLLER/PREFLIGHT/BUILD/LAUNCH/REPORTER against the sealed SF6 CONTROLLER.py and the authoritative SF2_ENGINE.py.
findings: SF7 CONTROLLER.py is derived from the sealed SF6 CONTROLLER.py with exactly two classes of change: (1) the anneal branch and LR_SCHEDULE.json dependency are removed; English LR is the single hardcoded constant 5e-5 applied identically to both arms; (2) one new function (margin_hinge_term/margin_gap) computes a pairwise first-answer-token log-prob gap from the SAME forward-pass logits already used for factual CE, and its hinge output is added to the English loss ONLY when --arm treatment. No other scientific line differs: data (TRAIN.json/SCHEDULE.json), KL pool/lambda/positions, binding rehearsal/LR/localization constant, optimizer hyperparameters/clip, parameter scope, evaluation/scoring/gating code (E.panel/E.checks/E.measure_d3/E.acquire, gates()) are byte-identical in call sites to SF6/SF2. The acquisition/retention gate thresholds and definitions are unchanged; the new margin quantity does not appear anywhere in gates(). Transfer/HELDOUT/ALTERNATE/COPY/COMPETING panels are not referenced anywhere in the new source.
limitations: N=3 same-seed pairs is suggestive only; a single treatment success is not proof of reliability. Prefix noise before divergence is not an endpoint bound.
root_addendum: Before sealing, confirmed the margin term acts strictly on the first-answer-token position of the pre-existing CE logits tensor (no separate forward pass, no full-string scoring, no EOS-token involvement, no candidate-string change, no data reweighting). Confirmed classification labels (TREATMENT_FAVORED/CONTROL_FAVORED/MIXED/NO_CLEAR_DIFFERENCE/TREATMENT_FAILED_RETENTION/INCONCLUSIVE_EARLY_STOP) are defined in PROTOCOL.json before any run, with TREATMENT_FAILED_RETENTION taking priority over any favorable acquisition count. No gate changes, no outcomes observed prior to this review.
